items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: In 1914 and 1915, I was with Giordina... he picked all good men that could teach me something.

ctx.x: When you first started beating drums, how old were you?

Well, I was playing in 1912, actually, making a dollar. In 1913, I got a little better. In 1914 and 1915, I was with Giordina. The reason I like Giordina's band is because, first of all, he could be independent. He had a good job, and he picked all good men that could teach me something. You understand? You play with a bad band, you're a young man to learn. Every man in his band was qualified. In fact, even these bands are today. Any of them down the street wouldn't play the rags that Giordina played that time. I…
They can't cut those standard high-class rags?
